description: Picks the planes that get the Show's full-screen poster; every other plane stays on the small card, route and all. A plane gets it when it is the first of its kind today (airline and type, e.g. UAL-B738, or PVT-<type> for private aircraft; kinds that had a poster are kept in todo.plane_posters_today, which planes_overhead_count clears at midnight) or when it is unusual: a helicopter, a balloon, a wide-body, a person of interest's aircraft (plane-alert-db) or a private jet with a registered owner. The last two come from sensor.plane_details, which pairs a flight up to 30 s after it enters, so a plane that is neither waits up to 40 s for that. Never 22:00-07:00, never on the ground, never flight-school and local VFR traffic (plane_boring). script.plane_poster shows the poster, at most once every 5 minutes. Before 2026-11-04 every plane got one and Denver departures brought it up every 9 minutes. Source: ha-dashboard/automations/planes_overhead_takeover.json

variables.special: {% from 'planes.jinja' import plane_key %}{% set t = (trigger.event.data.aircraft_code or '') | upper %}{{ plane_key(trigger.event.data) | trim in ['MIL-H47', 'GEN-HELI', 'GEN-BALLOON'] or t[:3] in ['B74', 'B76', 'B77', 'B78', 'A33', 'A34', 'A35', 'A38', 'MD1'] or t in ['A306', 'A310'] }}

actions.wait_template: {{ first or special or (state_attr('sensor.plane_details', 'by_fr24') or {}).get(fid) is not none }}

variables.notable: {% from 'planes.jinja' import plane_key %}{% set x = (state_attr('sensor.plane_details', 'by_fr24') or {}).get(fid) or {} %}{{ x.get('poi', false) or (not trigger.event.data.airline_icao and x.get('owner', '') != '' and plane_key(trigger.event.data) | trim in ['GEN-C56X', 'GEN-CL35', 'GEN-GLEX', 'GEN-NARROW']) }}
